edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the 'from' address of every transfer path.
tx.origin is used to enforce the one-purchase-per-block transfer delay, making the anti-bot check origin-dependent.
block.timestamp drives the early sell tax and first-buy timestamp logic inside _transfer.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline in addLiquidity.
_transfer reads and writes _holderLastTransferTimestamp keyed by tx.origin.
_transfer records and reads _holderFirstBuyTimestamp using block.timestamp for early sell tax.
_transfer reads and mutates the blacklist mapping.
_transfer compares block.number against launchedAt for the sniper window.
_transfer mutates sellTotalFees based on the early sell tax path.
_transfer sets and clears the swapping reentrancy guard around swapBack.
_transfer triggers the internal swapBack path, performing external calls during a transfer.
_transfer calls swapBack which performs external router calls and ETH transfers.
swapBack performs a low-level ETH call to devWallet before finishing state accounting.
swapBack performs a low-level ETH call to marketingWallet using the whole balance.
swapBack invokes swapTokensForEth which makes an external router call.
swapBack invokes addLiquidity which makes an external router call.
swapBack reads and zeroes tokensForLiquidity for allocation.
swapBack reads and zeroes tokensForMarketing for allocation.
swapBack reads and zeroes tokensForDev for allocation.
swapBack reads devWallet to send ETH.
swapBack reads marketingWallet to send remaining ETH.
swapTokensForEth calls the router swap external operation.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router and its WETH path.
addLiquidity calls the router addLiquidityETH external operation.
addLiquidity reads uniswapV2Router for the approval and call.
Send loops over transferFrom calls to arbitrary recipients.
msg.sender is the source of tokens pushed in Send.
Send uses owner()/_owner to self-approve the total supply before transfers.
onlyOwner restricts enableTrading to the owner (msg.sender check).
enableTrading sets tradingActive permanently.
enableTrading records launchedAt block number.
enableTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
onlyOwner restricts excludeFromFees to the owner.
excludeFromFees writes the fee exclusion mapping.
onlyOwner restricts setAutomatedMarketMakerPair.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private setter.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the AMM pair mapping.
onlyOwner restricts ManageBot blacklisting.
ManageBot writes the blacklist mapping.
onlyOwner restricts updateBuyFees.
updateBuyFees writes buyTotalFees.
onlyOwner restricts updateSellFees.
updateSellFees writes sellTotalFees and early sell fees.
onlyOwner restricts updateMaxTxnAmount.
updateMaxTxnAmount recomputes maxTransactionAmount with multiplication.
onlyOwner restricts updateMaxWalletAmount.
updateMaxWalletAmount recomputes maxWallet with multiplication.
onlyOwner restricts updateSwapTokensAtAmount.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes swapTokensAtAmount after supply-ratio checks.
onlyOwner restricts updateMarketingWallet.
updateMarketingWallet writes marketingWallet.
onlyOwner restricts updateDevWallet.
updateDevWallet writes devWallet.
recipients array drives the Send loop targets.
values array drives the Send transfer amounts.
local fee amount computed with mul/div in _transfer.
contract token balance controls the canSwap branch in _transfer.
newNum parameter is scaled into maxTransactionAmount.
newAmount parameter becomes the new swap threshold.
account parameter is the blacklist target.
isBlacklisted parameter is the blacklist value.
newMarketingWallet parameter becomes the marketing wallet.
newWallet parameter becomes the dev wallet.
contractBalance local caps the amount processed in swapBack.
totalTokensToSwap local is the denominator for fee allocations in swapBack.
liquidityTokens local is halved and subtracted from the swap amount.
tokenAmount parameter is used in the router liquidity call.
ethAmount parameter is forwarded as value in the router liquidity call.
